Name: Dialogue Display Framework
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod is a modder's resource, it doesn't do anything by itself. For mods that implements this framework, see:

[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11662]Advanced Dialogue Display[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11670]Hearts and Gifts Dialogue Display[/url]﻿

[/list]
It allows for the creation of Content Patcher mods that change the way NPC dialogue boxes are displayed in the following ways:

[list]
[*]Position, width, color, and size of the dialogue text and the character name
[*]Scroll background for the character name
[*]Position of the character portrait
[*]Width and height of the dialogue box
[*]Position, size, and animation of the friendship jewel
[*]Position and size of the action button
[/list]
The mod also allows the addition of the following custom elements to NPC dialogue boxes:

[list]
[*]A character sprite like in character profile pages that can be animated, shown with or with out background, and leads to the profile page when clicked.
[*]The current hearts attained with this character (including partial hearts), with or without empty hearts
[*]Weekly gift indicator with or without the gift icon
[*]Any number of custom images using Content Patcher paths
[*]Any number of custom texts with or without scroll backgrounds
[*]Any number of horizontal or vertical dividers
[/list]

[url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods/blob/master/DialogueDisplayFramework/assets/api.md]Full API information for creating your own content pack is here.[/url]﻿


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], uses Harmony.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].
